key_insight: EgoForce uses the visible forearm as a stable geometric anchor to resolve depth and scale ambiguity in monocular, head-mounted RGB images, enabling direct reconstruction of absolute 3D hand pose and shape in camera space from a single egocentric view.
problem_solved: Monocular egocentric hand reconstruction suffers from depth–scale ambiguity and poor generalization across varied head-mounted camera configurations; the paper addresses how to recover absolute, camera-relative 3D hand pose/shape reliably from a single wearable camera without bulky sensors.
method: Detect and model the forearm region together with the hand, using the forearm as a known-scale geometric cue to disambiguate hand depth and global scale.
Train a single RGB-based network to regress camera-space hand pose and shape (absolute 3D coordinates) by combining forearm-guided features, kinematic/shape priors, and camera-space supervision.
Leverage mixed data and augmentation strategies to generalize across head-mounted optical configurations and to make predictions robust to occlusions and partial views.
impact: Provides a practical, lightweight solution for absolute egocentric hand tracking from commodity head-mounted cameras, improving realism and interaction fidelity for AR/VR, telepresence, and hand-centric robotics while reducing reliance on additional depth sensors or markers.
visual_elements: Schematic of a head-mounted monocular camera viewing the forearm and hand, with an arrow showing 'forearm anchor' -> 'camera-space pose'.
Architecture block diagram: input image → forearm+hand detector → pose/shape regressor → camera-space 3D output.
Before/after comparison: monocular prediction with scale ambiguity vs. EgoForce absolute camera-space reconstruction.
Quantitative bar chart of error reduction (depth/scale metrics) across different headset camera configurations.
paper_title: EgoForce: Forearm-Guided Camera-Space 3D Hand Pose from a Monocular Egocentric Camera
paper_authors: Christen Millerdurai, Shaoxiang Wang, Yaxu Xie, Vladislav Golyanik, Didier Stricker
